comparison.objective: Hold a spring-return safety loop released while operating a separate bottle rocker; the candidate locks an adjustable gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual contact against a returning spring while actuating another control, not seated driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Loop must remain released while the rocker opens the bottle; releasing the loop prevents success, with final physical opening required.
comparison.reason: Both require two simultaneous roles, but the safety interlock ability differs from preserving a screw setting during locknut tightening.
